scope: Owned records extracted from a mixed source file. JSON pointers refer to the exact source revision; this is not the complete original file.

value.intent: Adapt approved business character identity into a selectable cosmetic variant.
reference_requirements: Actual inspected approved identity or explicitly labeled original placeholder, character variation brief and display target.
value.prompt: Inspect {{IDENTITY_REFERENCE}} and create the requested NAVI NETWORK variation described by {{CHARACTER_BRIEF}} for {{DISPLAY_TARGET}}. Preserve the supplied identity accurately; if it is an original C-token or unverified mascot concept, retain that label and do not claim an exact official Coupa Navi reproduction. Keep the character friendly, compact and readable, with an independently replaceable pulse/accent or connection cue where supported. A starter guide and an earned auditor-themed cosmetic can differ in silhouette detail or material without implying real customer savings, changed speed or new AI capability. Keep process-friction obstacles abstract and introduce no military imagery or nationality-coded enemies. Preserve the original source, save a derived copy and record the complete prompt and parent asset. Generated labels should not replace actual localized UI. Inspect real output dimensions, alpha and small-size clarity, then apply the asset through the existing preview only when that step is requested and available. Report concept, applied visual and inspected motion readiness separately.
value.example_request: Adapt the supplied Navi placeholder into an earned auditor look, retaining honest brand status and business imagery.
